description: Cost pressure dominates household behavior and weakens discretionary spending.
Consumers become skeptical of platforms claims hidden fees AI and data practices.
Commerce becomes highly personalized through AI recommendation ranking and pricing systems.
Responsible options become more available through regulation infrastructure and market redesign.
Consumers cluster around values communities cultures creators and trust networks.
Consumer protection privacy and platform rules reshape digital commerce.
Inclusive design accessibility and fair access become central market capabilities.
Personalization friction dark patterns and data extraction intensify consumer vulnerability.
